<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Qwen3.5's dense MLP runs SiLU*mul and the NVFP4 quantization of the down_proj input as one FlashInfer kernel. Qwen3 uses `Qwen2MLP`, which lacks that path, so its NVFP4 W4A4 MLPs write the activation in 16 bits (`act_and_mul`) and read it back (`fp4_quantize`).

## Modifications

- Move the fused call and its enabling check from `Qwen2MoeMLP` / `qwen3_5.py` to `models/utils.py` and give `Qwen2MLP` the same branch, enabled only by `Qwen3DecoderLayer` when both projections use ModelOpt NVFP4 W4A4. Other `Qwen2MLP` users are unchanged.
- Keep it off for NVFP4 AWQ, whose `pre_quant_scale` the fused kernel skips (#38864 adds the same check to the Qwen3.5 copy), and, per forward, under sequence parallelism or with a LoRA-wrapped down_proj, which read the activation tensor (as `DualGemm.can_run` does). Without the LoRA check, a Qwen3 NVFP4 server with a down_proj adapter fails at startup.
- CPU unit tests for the three gates.

## Accuracy Tests

- The fused FP4 data and block scales are bit-identical to the two-kernel path (M = 128 to 40960, intermediate size 9728).
- `Qwen3-Embedding-4B` NVFP4 on 60 questions each of Ko-StrategyQA / MIRACL-ko: Recall@10 0.876 / 0.767 and the distance to BF16 scores are identical to main.
- `Qwen3-Reranker-4B` NVFP4 as a causal LM (CUDA graphs on), and `Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B` NVFP4 with a down_proj LoRA adapter: greedy outputs match main.
- `test_qwen3_5_modelopt_fp4.py`: 12 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), FlashInfer 0.7.1. `Qwen3-Embedding-4B` NVFP4, GPU time of one `encode` call on 128 sequences:

| 128 sequences | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 320 tokens | 455.6 ms | **419.0 ms** (-8.0%) |
| 640 tokens | 925.1 ms | **844.2 ms** (-8.7%) |

Decode throughput of `Qwen3-Reranker-4B` NVFP4 at batch 1 / 16 / 64 is unchanged.

<details>
<summary>The kernels alone (CUPTI, cold L2), SiLU*mul + NVFP4 quantization of a [M, 2 x 9728] BF16 input</summary>

| M | `silu_and_mul` + `fp4_quantize` | fused |
|---|---|---|
| 1024 | 28.4 us | 9.4 us |
| 8192 | 444.1 us | 249.9 us |
| 40960 | 2294.8 us | 1251.9 us |

</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

+        mlp._enable_silu_fp4_quant_fusion
+        and not isinstance(gate_up, tuple)
+        and not get_forward().sp_active  # the SP g-bar matmul needs a tensor
+        and not hasattr(mlp.down_proj, "base_layer")  # LoRA reads the activation

+def silu_and_mul_fp4_quant(

+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:

+    from flashinfer import silu_and_mul_scaled_nvfp4_experts_quantize

+    # the fused kernel requires a 1-D global scale.

+        mlp._masked_m_cache[num_tokens] = masked_m

+        gate_up.unsqueeze(0),

+class TestSiluFp4QuantFusionGates(CustomTestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _enabled_mlp(down_proj) -> SimpleNamespace:
+        return SimpleNamespace(_enable_silu_fp4_quant_fusion=True, down_proj=down_proj)
+
+    def test_runs_for_a_plain_down_proj(self):
+        mlp = self._enabled_mlp(SimpleNamespace())
+        self.assertTrue(can_run_silu_fp4_quant_fusion(mlp, torch.empty(2, 32)))
+
+    def test_skips_a_lora_wrapped_down_proj(self):
+        mlp = self._enabled_mlp(SimpleNamespace(base_layer=SimpleNamespace()))
+        self.assertFalse(can_run_silu_fp4_quant_fusion(mlp, torch.empty(2, 32)))
+
+    def test_skips_under_sequence_parallelism(self):
+        mlp = self._enabled_mlp(SimpleNamespace())
+        with get_forward().scoped(sp_active=True):
+            self.assertFalse(can_run_silu_fp4_quant_fusion(mlp, torch.empty(2, 32)))
+
+    def test_stays_off_for_nvfp4_awq(self):
+        # The fused producer would skip AWQ's per-input-channel pre_quant_scale.
+        method = MagicMock(spec=ModelOptFp4LinearMethod, quant_mode="w4a4")
+        method.quant_config = SimpleNamespace(is_awq=True)
+        mlp = SimpleNamespace(
+            _enable_silu_fp4_quant_fusion=False,
+            gate_up_proj=SimpleNamespace(quant_method=method),
+            down_proj=SimpleNamespace(quant_method=method),
+        )
+        maybe_enable_silu_fp4_quant_fusion(mlp)
+        self.assertFalse(mlp._enable_silu_fp4_quant_fusion)
